mapper.select: SELECT dept_idx FROM user_mst WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
SELECT dept_nm FROM dept_mst WHERE dept_idx = #{deptIdx}
SELECT user_id FROM user_mst WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
SELECT user_name FROM user_mst WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
SELECT target_dept_idx FROM team_view_permission WHERE viewer_user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} AND can_view = 'Y'

SELECT d.dept_idx AS deptIdx, d.dept_nm AS deptNm, TRUE AS granted FROM team_view_permission tvp JOIN dept_mst d ON d.dept_idx = tvp.target_dept_idx WHERE tvp.viewer_user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} AND tvp.can_view = 'Y' ORDER BY d.dept_nm

SELECT u.user_idx AS userIdx, u.user_name AS userName, u.dept_idx AS deptIdx, d.dept_nm AS deptNm, (u.user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx}) AS selfUser FROM user_mst u LEFT JOIN dept_mst d ON d.dept_idx = u.dept_idx WHERE u.user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} OR u.dept_idx IN ( SELECT target_dept_idx FROM team_view_permission WHERE viewer_user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} AND can_view = 'Y' ) ORDER BY selfUser DESC, d.dept_nm NULLS LAST, u.user_name

SELECT CASE WHEN #{assigneeUserIdx} = #{viewerUserIdx} THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mst u JOIN team_view_permission tvp ON tvp.target_dept_idx = u.dept_idx AND tvp.viewer_user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} AND tvp.can_view = 'Y' WHERE u.user_idx = #{assigneeUserIdx} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

SELECT aps.plan_date AS planDate, aps.store_idx AS storeIdx, sm.store_nm AS storeNm, cm.code_nm AS brandNm, aps.assignee_user_idx AS assigneeUserIdx, u.user_name AS assigneeUserName, TRUE AS planned, FALSE AS completed FROM activity_plan_store aps JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_idx = aps.assignee_user_idx JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = aps.store_idx LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON sm.brand_cd = cm.code_cd AND cm.grp_cd = 40 WHERE aps.plan_date >= #{monthStart} AND aps.plan_date < #{monthEnd} AND
AND aps.assignee_user_idx IN
#{id}
ORDER BY aps.plan_date, aps.sort_order, aps.plan_store_idx

SELECT am.act_dt AS planDate, am.store_idx AS storeIdx, sm.store_nm AS storeNm, cm.code_nm AS brandNm, u.user_idx AS assigneeUserIdx, u.user_name AS assigneeUserName, FALSE AS planned, TRUE AS completed FROM active_mst am JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_id = am.sv_id JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = am.store_idx LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON sm.brand_cd = cm.code_cd AND cm.grp_cd = 40 WHERE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(am.appr_status, ''))) = 'APPROVED' AND am.act_dt >= #{monthStart} AND am.act_dt < #{monthEnd} AND
AND u.user_idx IN
#{id}
ORDER BY am.act_dt, am.act_idx

SELECT aps.plan_date AS planDate, aps.store_idx AS storeIdx, sm.store_nm AS storeNm, cm.code_nm AS brandNm, aps.assignee_user_idx AS assigneeUserIdx, u.user_name AS assigneeUserName, TRUE AS planned, FALSE AS completed FROM activity_plan_store aps JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_idx = aps.assignee_user_idx JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = aps.store_idx LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON sm.brand_cd = cm.code_cd AND cm.grp_cd = 40 WHERE aps.assignee_user_idx = #{assigneeUserIdx} AND aps.plan_date = #{planDate} ORDER BY aps.sort_order, aps.plan_store_idx

SELECT am.act_dt AS planDate, am.store_idx AS storeIdx, sm.store_nm AS storeNm, cm.code_nm AS brandNm, u.user_idx AS assigneeUserIdx, u.user_name AS assigneeUserName, FALSE AS planned, TRUE AS completed FROM active_mst am JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_id = am.sv_id JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = am.store_idx LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON sm.brand_cd = cm.code_cd AND cm.grp_cd = 40 WHERE u.user_idx = #{assigneeUserIdx} AND am.act_dt = #{planDate} AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(am.appr_status, ''))) = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY am.act_idx
